title: Correct refractive index
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be the numerical value √2 or its decimal equivalent.

title: Correct propagation time
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be expressed as (√2 l)/(2c) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Geometry at face AB
description: Important: The student must correctly identify the incident and refraction angles (45° and 30°) at the exit face AB using the given deviation.

title: Application of Snell's Law
description: Important: The student must apply Snell's law (n = sin(i)/sin(r)) correctly at the exit interface to find the refractive index.

title: Path length in medium
description: Important: The student must correctly determine the geometric path length traveled inside the prism (e.g., l/2) from the given midpoint condition.

title: Speed from refractive index
description: Important: The student must correctly relate the speed in the medium to the refractive index using v = c/n.

title: Time calculation
description: Optional: The student correctly calculates the time using t = (path length) / v, leading to the final expression.

title: Sign or angle error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student confuses the incident and refraction angles at the exit face, or misinterprets the 15° deviation.

title: Unit omission or error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student provides a numerical answer without necessary symbolic constants (c, l) or makes a dimensional error in the time expression.
